Actual BCF staging then exposed lost franchise identity after creation and saved-slot navigation; reports/staging-browser-s112.json preserves that failure. The fifth outcome now preserves per-tab identity/progress, rejects changed durable references before replacement, and makes failed checkpoint retry independent of command replay. Final release acceptance remains pending; the interrupted BCF canonical1199-test run and earlier failed/readiness checks remain historical, not green acceptance.

S111 required a repair after capture hashes were omitted from the append-only ledger. The receipt writer now publishes ledger entries immediately after its immutable full-proof receipt, while rejecting provisional or incomplete proof.

The actual BCF staging /api/new-league request selected CHI, seed 20260306 and play mode and returned 200 with fa-20260306-CHI; normal full-page game navigation created fa-4089734262-BUF instead. An explicit manual slot1 save/load returned 200 with that saved franchise, but subsequent navigation created fa-4089748847-BUF. Correct route/status/artifact identity did not preserve the active client runtime.
secondOrderCandidates.implementation: Per-tab compressed checkpoint recovery after successful local mutations, loading/unsaved states, checkpoint-only retry and guarded navigation. A small integrity-bound reference may point only to an explicitly selected or saved existing slot when a full checkpoint exceeds sessionStorage quota. Save responses expose savedSnapshotIntegrity; reference loads submit expectedSavedSnapshotIntegrity and verify the exact frozen saved snapshot before replacing either the local or server runtime. A separate live-state fingerprint excludes only league.observability when deciding whether the current session still matches that explicit save. Changed or missing references fail closed. Manual saves and exports remain the authority for keeping a franchise after tab close. Snapshot serialization, hashing and codec capture/restore run inside the worker; only compact encoded checkpoints and identity receipts cross its port. Capture/restore share the existing request queue and storage acknowledgment barrier. Setup locks runtime selection while a command/checkpoint is pending, and a new selection or runtime switch cancels old deferred navigation.
secondOrderCandidates.diagnosis: Reloading an unchanged saved snapshot legitimately recalculates 350 derived leaf values, including weekly plans, opponent data and pressure. Comparing raw saved bytes with the reconstructed runtime therefore rejected an unchanged save. The fix binds integrity to the frozen saved snapshot before runtime replacement instead of exempting gameplay fields from integrity checks. Request diagnostics are excluded only from the separate live-state fingerprint.

performance.finding: One completed season: maximum checkpoint main-thread tasks fell from735/892ms to58/71ms for Drive/Play. Flush wall times were1432/1684ms versus1368/1614ms; total latency did not improve. Fresh checkpoints had no observed tasks at or above50ms. Single warm local samples, not a benchmark distribution or mature-career claim. Isolated restore timing was not measured.
